## Log

Attach `circadia.log` from the `logs` folder in Circadia's data folder (`%LOCALAPPDATA%\Circadia\logs` unless you started Circadia with `--data-dir`). If the folder also has `circadia.1.log`, attach it too; it has the older records.

The log can contain personal data, such as coordinates, executable names, file paths, and window titles. Before attaching it, remove anything you do not want to share.
